main.description: Sets a community's picture or banner. The bytes are uploaded to the community's own repo, which is why this goes through the AppView: a community's blobs can only be written with the community credentials the AppView holds, and a space record must reference a blob living in the repo that holds the record. Replaces whatever was there before.

community.description: The community to set the image on.

input.description: The raw image bytes. The content type must be one of image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif or image/webp, and is sniffed rather than trusted.

community.description: The community with the new image resolved, so one call is enough to re-render.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the community.manage permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists with that DID.

errors.name: UnsupportedImage
errors.description: The bytes are not one of the accepted image types.

errors.name: ImageTooLarge
errors.description: The image exceeds the size limit for this kind.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView's stored credentials for this community are missing or unusable.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: A PDS or third-party call the AppView depends on failed.
